title: SGD with momentum

paper.title: Some methods of speeding up the convergence of iteration methods
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement SGD with momentum: implement velocity updates on an ill-conditioned quadratic and a tiny MLP. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use synthetic-classification; required output: [N,D] -> [N,C] logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). Explicit v=beta*v+grad and w-=lr*v; record quadratic objective for beta zero and nonzero. Required ablation: Set momentum to zero at the same learning rate and compare objective traces.

dataset.description: Explicit v=beta*v+grad and w-=lr*v; record quadratic objective for beta zero and nonzero
dataset.split_policy: Disjoint train/validation/test examples; fit preprocessing using training data only.
